DEMOTED to active 2026-10-28: the event spool is in-memory only (no disk durability, no replay after a failed events POST — drain() splices before the POST) and the supervisor computes a wall-clock deadline then discards it (void deadline). Remaining: disk-backed append/fsync spool with replay-on-reconnect, drain-after-ack, monotonic deadline derived from lease expiry that aborts the in-flight job.
